function.name: Supply chain and logistics
function.description: Forecasting demand, holding stock, moving goods.

jobs.name: Forecast demand per item and location
jobs.outcome: A demand forecast at the item and location level that beats the naive baseline and the previous method.

jobs.name: Plan delivery routes that cut miles and keep windows
jobs.outcome: Daily routes meet delivery windows with fewer miles and vehicles than the previous plan.

jobs.name: Propose reorders that keep service levels within stock targets
jobs.outcome: Reorder proposals hold the service level while lowering stock, and a planner approves most without change.

jobs.name: Detect shipments that will miss their window
jobs.outcome: Delays are detected from carrier and telemetry data early enough to re-plan or warn the customer.
